export_controls.text: I rise today to express deep concern and frustration over President Trump’s decision to approve the sale of advanced Nvidia H200 AI chips to the People’s Republic of China. I am worried that the transfer of these chips will compromise U.S. security and enable the People’s Republic of China to catch up in one area where the U.S. has a significant and very qualitative advantage over the PRC.

deepseek.reason: He opposes approving H200 chip sales to China because they would compromise U.S. security.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly criticizes the chip sale approval and cites security harm.

export_controls.text: The H200 is used to train and deploy frontier AI systems—systems that U.S. national security agencies have long warned have numerous military and intelligence applications. [...] Even the CEO of China’s leading AI firm has admitted publicly that the access to advanced chips is their biggest bottleneck. President Trump is now solving this problem for China.

deepseek.reason: He criticizes Trump for solving China's advanced-chip access bottleneck.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly opposes easing China's access to advanced AI chips.
